final: WITH g AS (SELECT arcref AS pid, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g), f AS (SELECT g.pid, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS frac FROM g JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(frac) AS avgfrac FROM f) SELECT f.pid, f.cnt, f.frac, f.frac - a.avgfrac AS diff FROM f JOIN a ON a.avgfrac IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
